note: One thing that led to a death: when it happened, what sort of thing it was, and what did it. What follows the opening is settled by the sort, and one sort has been observed.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of thing it was. Every entry observed carries the same one, and what other sorts carry is not recorded here.
